prompts.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL professional pixel-art RPG elemental effects sprite sheet on true transparent background, no characters, no words, no labels, no grid lines, no panels, no floor, no shadows, no gold halo or circles. Wide landscape image ideally 1536x768. EXACTLY THREE equal rows and SIX equal columns = 18 isolated effect sprites. Each slot has at least 25% EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on all four sides; all ink inside central half of its slot, NEVER touching adjacent sprites. Crisp deliberately pixel-stepped outlines, restrained material palettes, readable discrete shapes, no soft photoreal glow; consistent dense-pixel style suitable next to detailed cute creature sprites in a 2D creature-collector. All effects face RIGHT, tails trail LEFT. In each row the six separate cells left-to-right form: 1 small charge gathering the material, 2 launch pose, 3 coherent traveling projectile A, 4 traveling projectile B with subtly changed material motion, 5 strong target-impact material shape, 6 smaller dissipating impact with remaining material fragments. Do NOT draw a traveling trail extending outside a cell. Every cell must be populated. Row 1: LEAF: three slender sharp pointed green leaf blades, visible pale veins, forest green outlines and lime faces; impact two crossed leaf cuts with torn tips. Row 2: WATER: coherent curved cyan water jet, long continuous teal water tail and white foam; impact a blue crown splash and round droplets. Row 3: STONE: one solid jagged faceted tan-grey rock with dark umber outline and chips; impact a broken angular rock with sharp chunks and dust. Keep the material identity the same across all six cells in each row; the size of the impact can be larger than the charge. Aim for a beautiful high-quality production sprite sheet, clean silhouette, distinctive materials even in greyscale. No generic magic circles.

spacingPrompt: Repair ONLY spacing of this transparent pixel-art sprite atlas. Preserve all 18 original effects and material identities, six poses of each of three elements, their palettes and silhouettes. EXACT SIX COLUMNS, THREE ROWS. SIGNIFICANTLY SHRINK EVERY isolated sprite: each must be only 40% of the width and 40% of the height of its uniform cell, centered exactly in its slot. Leave 30% empty transparent space on every side of every cell. Even impact poses and all detached particles must stay inside that central 40% box. No fragments, glow, glitter or particles in gutters or from neighbors. NO labels, grid, floor, backdrop, shadows or borders. Retain true transparency. Keep left-to-right six columns charge, launch, travelA, travelB, impact, dissolve. Keep first-row/second-row/third-row material identities exactly as the reference. This is a clean production source with generous clear margins, not a new design. Preserve crisp detailed pixel art. All moving effects face right. Do not crop or remove any material: shrink the whole complete effect including its detached fragments so it fits.
